chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said: Whoever prays with them (the people) in the first row, it is as though he had prayed with the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) in the first row.

key_terms.الصَّفِّ الْأَوَّلِ: The first row — the foremost rank in congregational prayer, traditionally associated with the greatest reward
key_terms.فَكَأَنَّمَا: It is as though — a rhetorical device used in hadith to express the equivalent spiritual value of an act

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for praying in the first row of congregational prayer according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This hadith, attributed to one of the Imams (peace be upon him), teaches the immense spiritual reward of praying in the first row of congregational prayer alongside ordinary believers. The comparison to praying with the Prophet himself elevates congregational prayer in the first row to the highest spiritual honor, encouraging believers to prioritize communal worship. Historically, the first row in congregational prayer has always been considered the most meritorious position in Islamic tradition.
